environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with public internet-facing listener. The service runs 4 task replicas behind the ALB. MySQL 8.0 RDS instance with default transaction isolation level (REPEATABLE READ). The ALB is in a public subnet with security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. Application throttle is per-IP using Laravel's built-in rate limiter with cache driver set to 'file' (local to each container, not shared). An attacker can send concurrent requests from multiple IPs or exploit the per-container file-based rate limit isolation.
